title: Photo mode from Pause
summary: Pause has a Photo mode. It closes the menu, hides the HUD and controls, and leaves a free camera around the paused moment. Save photo writes one clean frame to a PNG.
details: Orbit with mouse drag, arrow keys, the right stick or one-finger drag. Pan, zoom and field of view have their own keys, pad controls and touch gestures.
The eye stays above the drawn ground, and the focus point stays within 120 ft of the rider.
Save photo draws one frame without controls. The browser downloads a PNG. Desktop writes the picture to the Pictures folder.
Back returns to Pause. The ride stays paused and untouched.
Split screen: only player 1's view takes the free camera. Online rooms do not show the row.
limitation: There is no roll control, because the scene camera has no roll. Photo mode is not offered in online rooms.
verification: Unit tests for the orbit camera, limits, pinch and drag, and controller edges. tools/test_engine_photo.mjs passes locally on desktop (orbit, wheel, field of view, a real PNG download, back to Pause) and on a phone (touch drag, pinch and Back tap). make precheck passes.
